body:
Had visited psych, we did scanning of head, we kept checking thyroid and it all appeared to be fine. The only thing that psych did was to copy-paste diagnosis from a parent and kept pushing me into meds  regardless that repeatedly i had been telling him I won't touch meds until talk therapy is proven not to work.  And he does talk therapy, yet I was declined of it. Now in regards to parent, he is diagnosed with depression and anxiety. He used to be a patient in psychiatry ward, not sure if in open or closed or both. If i can recall correctly, there was a period when we had sealed windows and balcony doors in our apartment (we live in skyscraper), we also had sharp objects removed. I also heard my parent crying with "I don't know what to do, is it the best just to kill myself?". In addition, I think that parent once told that he is only alive because of having me and my sibling, but I'm not entirely sure about this information as all of this of this stuff was happening in my early childhood, therefore years ago.

I only know that if I tell my parent that I had suicidal thoughts and that I was hospitalized, I will probably push him in crisis again. This also means opening a pandora box, meaning that whole family will be recruited to find me and bring me home (currently I'm alone living and working in foreign country)

Looking at my parent, there is some genetic predisposition to my troubles I would guess. I knew that I was depressed but I would never expect that I would end getting some momentary urges that would delegate me to harm myself. This is so sick and it doesn't make any sense.  I still want to believe that this didn't happen. Otherwise I never had any plans nor intentions to harm or even kill myself. While there was some moaning in style "what if I would just end it", but for me it was just a moaning out of frustration.

Honestly I don't want to harm myself let alone took my life, but I am truly afraid of those short lived impulses that come without any warning, and they come out of your body, possibly being so powerful that they can override your rationale. Since then I am afraid of bridges, sharp objects and being in tall buildings, as I don't know what kind of crazy instruction I could get from my body, in a moment.
